title: zephyranthes laeta
intro: Zephyranthes laeta, commonly known as the Golden Zephyr, is a type of flowering plant that belongs to the Amaryllidaceae family. It is a bulbous perennial native to Central and South America, known for its vibrant yellow flowers and slender leaves. The plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including anxiety and insomnia, due to its sedative and anxiolytic properties, which are attributed to its therapeutic actions. The bioactive constituents of Zephyranthes laeta include alkaloids, such as zephyranthine and other Amaryllidaceae-type compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential health benefits.
